## 2026 US Open prize money

The 2026 US Open will be held in New York from 30 August to 13 September.

The US Open has unveiled prize money for the 2026 edition of the hard-court major. The total prize money for this year’s tournament has risen to $108 million, a 20 per cent increase on 2025. [...] The men’s and women’s singles champions in New York will each earn $5.5 million.

## When and where is the 2026 U.S. Open?

The 2026 U.S. Open main draw will start on Sunday, Aug. 30, and last through Sunday, Sept. 13. Qualifying begins Monday, Aug. 24, and runs through Thursday, Aug. 27.
